Description

Enjoy a Smart Pumping Life!

*Upgrade to Efficiency, Upgrade to Portability

The 3rd-gen pump motor offers powerful suction up to -300mmHg to increase milk output

*Your Pattern, Your Comfort

Personalize patterns via the Momcozy app, adjusting mode and intensity to suit your comfort and preference

*Sealed with Comfort, Brimming with Confidence

Embrace a snug and comfortable fit, courtesy of the DoubleFit™ flange

*Liberate Your Pumping Journey

Streamlined design for mess-free milk expression, offering unmatched convenience, portability, and freedom

*Pump Without Limits

On a single charge, enjoy 4 to 5 pumping sessions, ideal for busy moms pumping on-the-go

⚠️
Safety Warning

Do NOT use this device if you have a cardiac pacemaker, implanted defibrillator, or any other metallic or electronic implant, as it may cause electromagnetic interference or serious injury.

HSA/FSA Eligible: Save with pre-tax health dollars.

App Features Overview

Achieve discreet pumping control using our Momcozy app, ensuring privacy and convenience for confident and empowered pumping sessions anywhere.

Pumping Settings Adjustment:
Easily switch between different pumping settings to customize your experience for comfort and efficiency.

Milk Volume Tracking:
Record and monitor milk expression amounts per session to track progress and maintain a detailed log.

Personal Alerts and Notifications:
Set personalized alerts and receive notifications via the app to stay informed about your pumping schedule and important reminders.

Pumping Modes Overview

1. Professional Recommendations
-
Easily Select via Momcozy App

Experience two expert-recommended pumping modes tailored to your needs, promoting a smooth and enjoyable pumping session.

Milk Boost™: Ideal for moms looking to increase milk supply, this mode enhances breastfeeding by boosting production.

Milk Relief™: Provides balanced milk flow with Quick Release, offering gentle relief and effective milk expression for moms with enlarged breasts, without wasting time.

2. Personalized Preferences – Customize Conveniently via Momcozy App

MyFlow™ Mode: Set your own mode by adjusting the regular mode (stimulation, expression, or mixed) and intensity through the Momcozy app, allowing for a personalized pumping experience that optimizes comfort, efficiency, and milk production.

3. Regular Pumping Modes – Select via Momcozy App or Pump

Stimulation Mode: Features a quick, short sucking pattern to initiate milk flow.

Expression Mode: Provides a slow, steady sucking pattern for effective milk extraction.

Mixed Mode: Combines quick stimulation and slow expression patterns to efficiently extract milk.

This comprehensive range of modes and intensities offers flexibility and effectiveness, catering to various breastfeeding stages and individual preferences.

Specifications and Features

Perfect for working and multitasking moms

Effortlessly balance your career and breastfeeding with powerful efficiency.

Specifications

Modes: Personalized preferences + 2 professional modes (Milk Relief™ & Milk Boost™) + 3 regular modes (Stimulation, Expression, Mixed)
Adjustable Suction Levels: 15 levels for your comfort
Motor: 3rd-Gen motor delivering superior performance
Vacuum Strength: Up to -300mmHg for efficient milk expression
Flange Size: 24mm (with insert options of 17mm / 19mm / 21mm)
Maximum Usage Time: Up to 150 minutes (4 to 5 pumping sessions)
Noise Level: Under 48dB for quiet pumping
Bottle Capacity: 150ml
Auto Shut-Off: After 30 minutes
Charging Time: About 2.5 hours
Pump Dimensions: 5.0 in × 4.3 in × 3.0 in (127 mm × 109 mm × 77 mm)
Pump Weight: 10.7 oz (302 g)

FAQs

Is Momcozy M9 hospital-grade breast pump?

Momcozy M9 is a wearable, personal breast pump with
hospital-grade suction power
. It is helpful to know the distinction between a "hospital-grade" pump and "hospital-grade suction."

A "hospital-grade" breast pump is really a multi-user, rental pump designed for use in a hospital or clinic setting. They are made in a closed system so the milk won't get into the motor or tubing, so they can be shared with many mothers safely. They are most commonly for moms who need to establish their milk supply or moms with a baby in the NICU.

On the other hand, "hospital-grade suction power" refers to the suction power and cycle rate of the pump. This is used to refer to a pump that can produce sufficient suction to well initiate and maintain a milk supply by mimicking a powerful suckling baby.

Brief and to the point, the Momcozy M9 delivers powerful performance you need in a convenient, hands-free configuration that's perfect for personal, in-your-home-on-the-go applications. Unless you have a medical need for a multi-user pump, a personal pump with hospital-grade suction like the M9 should be ample power for your daily pumping needs.

What is the suction level of the Momcozy M9?

The Momcozy M9 offers a powerful
maximum suction strength of -300mmHg
, which is designed to be highly effective for milk expression. To give you full control and comfort, the pump provides 3 distinct modes:

Stimulation Mode to gently stimulate let-down.

Expression Mode for efficient milk output.

Mixed Mode which alternates between the two for a more natural feel.

You can further fine-tune the suction intensity across a total of 15 adjustable levels within these modes, allowing you to find the perfect setting for your comfort and milk flow.

Which is better, Momcozy M5, M6 or M9?

There is no single "best" pump among the Momcozy M5, M6, and M9;
the best choice depends on your personal needs and pumping style. The
key differences lie in their design, motor power, and advanced
features.

Can I get Momcozy M9 through insurance?

Yes
, you can get a Momcozy M9 breast pump through your insurance by working with one of our Durable Medical Equipment (DME) partners.

A DME partner is a professional firm that helps you get medical devices like breast pumps under your insurance plan. They approach your insurance company directly to provide the verification, authorization, and claims process on your behalf. You will require a prescription from a health care provider, e.g., a doctor or midwife, to begin with.

The most significant reasons for obtaining your pump from a DME partner are:

Cost Savings: The pump is generally paid for by the insurance at little or no cost to you.

Hassle-Free Process: Your DME partner takes care of all paperwork and communication with your insurance company.

Expert Guidance: They will arrange for all appropriate documentation to be submitted to meet insurance requirements.

Apart from the M9, our other top-selling breast pump models, the M5 and M6, can also be obtained through insurance.

Which is better, Spectra or Momcozy M9?

Both Spectra and Momcozy are trusted breast pump brands, but they are designed for different user needs, so the best choice depends on your lifestyle.

Spectra is best known for its traditional pumps with a large main unit and tubing that connects them. These pumps are most often used in a stationary setting, focusing on powerful, hospital-grade suction for optimal efficiency.

In comparison, the Momcozy M9 is a wearable, hands-free breast pump. Due to its all-in-one, foldable format, you can wear it in your bra while moving about, multitasking, or pumping anywhere without being tethered with tubes or plugged in. Therefore, if discretion and mobility are your top priorities, a wearable pump like the M9 will be best.

What Makes Momcozy M9 a Good, Smart, and Hands-Free Breast Pump?

The Momcozy M9 smart breast pump is designed for today’s busy moms who need a reliable, efficient, and discreet solution. As a hands-free breast pump, the M9 features powerful suction and efficient milk extraction—all in a lightweight, wearable design.

With app-controlled settings, you can easily adjust suction levels, modes, and track milk output right from your phone—no need to interrupt your routine. The portable and stackable milk collectors make it easy to pump on the go and store milk without the mess.

Whether you're juggling work, travel, or just daily life, the Momcozy M9 gives you the freedom to pump wherever and whenever you need, with comfort, confidence, and total control.

Do Wearable Pumps Decrease Milk Supply?

A wearable pump does not decrease milk supply, as long as it provides strong and effective suction. Suction strength is key to fully emptying the breast, which helps maintain a healthy milk supply.

Wearable pumps like the Momcozy S12 Pro are designed with high suction power to ensure efficient milk removal, so you can pump hands-free without compromising your milk production.

Can I Exclusively Pump with a Hands-Free Pump?

Yes, you can exclusively pump with a hands-free breast pump. In fact, many moms find hands-free pumping to be a convenient and effective way to build and maintain milk supply, especially when nursing isn’t an option.

The key is using a high-performance pump that fully empties the breasts. A smart, wearable option like the Momcozy M9, with powerful suction up to -300 mmHg and a comfortable DoubleFit™ flange, is designed to support exclusive pumping, without compromising comfort or milk output.

For the best results, it’s a good idea to consult with a lactation professional to create a pumping schedule that matches your goals.

What Is a Good Hands-Free Pump?

A good hands-free breast pump should offer strong suction, a comfortable fit, and quiet operation — all while giving moms the freedom to pump while multitasking. Look for a pump with adjustable suction levels, a leak-proof design, and discreet wearability for pumping confidently at work, at home, or on the go.

One top-rated option is the Momcozy M9. Designed with powerful suction up to -300 mmHg and a DoubleFit™ flange, it delivers efficient, leak-free pumping. The app-controlled settings let you personalize your pumping experience for maximum comfort and output. Its lightweight, wearable design makes it ideal for busy moms who want to pump hands-free anytime, anywhere.

Other notable choices include the Elvie Pump, known for its sleek design and ultra-quiet motor, perfect for discreet pumping in public.
